scripts.dev: bash -c 'UVICORN_BIN=/app/applet/.venv/bin/uvicorn; [ -f "$UVICORN_BIN" ] || UVICORN_BIN="python3 -m uvicorn"; PYTHONPATH="$(pwd)/backend:${PYTHONPATH:-}" $UVICORN_BIN app.main:app --app-dir backend --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001 --reload & cd frontend && ./node_modules/.bin/vite --port 3000 --host 0.0.0.0'
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && rm -rf ../dist && cp -r dist ../dist
